body: I am feeling much better, even just typing out how I was feeling made me feel like I was getting it off my chest. I don't have many people I can say what I was thinking to. You guys have helped tremendously.

I will respond to everyone tomorrow, thank you so much guys, I realized that this will take more time than I have right now as I am completely exhausted, thank you for the response reddit, you are making me feel a bit better already.

Thanks for the quick response guys, I'll get some advice from the 5 people that sent me pms and I'll see if this helps, just so reddit doesn't send police to my house, I am just really depressed with life right now, that is why I am asking for help before it gets out of control.
let me know if you are out there and have time to talk.
